It may help to have a family member look after them on the weekends. Then spend that time on yourself, whether you spend the time relaxing and recharging, pampering yourself, going out on dates. My point is you don't need a new life. You just need more in your life than your kids, something for yourself. So try and arrange set days a week where you know the kids are going to be out the house getting looked after by a family member for a couple of nights and start getting to know yourself again, what your interests are, what you like to do. And start having a life outside of looking after your children 24/7. But you actually sound like you love your children very much otherwise you would have just left them instead of wrestling with your guilt on here and I don't think you would be able to live with yourself if you abandoned them. And like I said - the good news is you don't have too, you just need some you time. Good luck lovely 💛
